Falls ja, welche Nachweise sind hierfür im Rahmen des Teilnahmeantrags bzw. Angebots erforderlich? Nein, neben festangestellten Mitarbeitenden können keine freien Mitarbeitende berücksichtigt werden (Dokument Erklärung zur Eignung, Punkt 2.2.1 Mitarbeiter) Sollten die geforderten personellen Eignungen mit den eigenen festangestellten Mitarbeitenden nicht vollständig erfüllt werden können, besteht die Möglichkeit, • eine Bietergemeinschaft zu bilden oder • eine Eignungsleihe in Anspruch zu nehmen. Die jeweils erforderlichen Nachweise sind dann gemäß den Vorgaben der Vergabeunterlagen im Angebot beizubringen. Anhaenge, Seite: 2 lfd. Les 18 communes mettent ainsi en commun leurs moyens pour relever de grands projets et certains défis tels que ceux de l’attractivité du territoire, le développement économique et celui de l’emploi, le logement, les transports (réseau de bus), la construction de grands équipements (tel qu’AquaMalo), l’eau et l’assainissement, la prévention et la collecte des déchets ou encore le développement de formations d’enseignement supérieur ... L’agglomération est gérée par des représentan t(e)s élu(e)s issu(e)s du conseil municipal de chacune des 18 communes (maire et/ou conseillers municipaux). V primeru skupne ponudbe lahko pogoj partnerji izpolnijo skupaj. V primeru, da ponudnik nastopa s podizvajalci, lahko pogoj ponudnik in podizvajalci dokazujejo skupno. DOKAZILO: - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz prve alineje prvega odstavka te točke: Izpolnjen obrazec P- 10 Referenca ponudnika. Referenca mora biti potrjena s strani naročnika referenčnega posla s podpisom. V kolikor se referenca nanaša na naročnika (Ministrstvo za zunanje in evropske zadeve), ponudnik izpolni vse podatke, vendar podpis reference s strani naročnika ni potreben. - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz druge alineje prvega odstavka te točke: ustrezna navedba v točki 3 obrazca P-2 Prijava in dokazila o izkušnjah ter sodelovanju strokovnjaka (npr. pogodba o zaposlitvi). 9.4.2 Vsi kadri ponudnika, ki bodo opravljali dela predmetnega javnega naročila, bodo varnostno preverjeni s strani naročnika v skladu z 16a. členom Zakona o zunanjih zadevah (Uradni list RS št. 113/03– uradno prečiščeno besedilo, s spremembami in dopo

zvesti javno naročilo s podizvajalcem, ki zahteva neposredno plačilo, mora: - glavni izvajalec v pogodbi pooblastiti naročnika, da na podlagi potrjenega računa oziroma situacije s strani glavnega izvajalca neposredno plačuje podizvajalcu, - podizvajalec predložiti soglasje, na podlagi katerega naročnik namesto ponudnika poravna podizvajalčevo terjatev do ponudnika, - glavni i zvajalec svojemu računu ali situaciji priložiti račun ali situacijo podizvajalca, ki ga je predhodno potrdil. V primeru nastopanja s podizvajalci, kjer ni neposrednega plačila, mora glavni izvajalec najpozneje v 60 dneh od plačila končnega računa oziroma situacije poslati naročniku svojo pisno izjavo in pisno izjavo podizvajalca, da je podizvajalec prejel plačilo za izvedene gradnje ali storitve oziroma dobavljeno blago, neposredno povezano s predmetom javnega naročila. V nasprotnem primeru naročnik Državni revizijski komisiji poda predlog za uvedbo postopka o prekršku iz 2. točke prvega odstavka 112. člena ZJN-3. Ponudnik v razmerju do naročnika v celoti odgovarja za izvedbo prejetega naročila, ne glede na število podizvajalcev, ki jih navede v svoji ponudbi. Izbrani izvajalec bo moral med izvajanjem javnega naročila naročnika obvestiti o morebitnih spremembah glede podizvajalcev, ki jih namerava nakn

avnem varstvu v postopkih javnega naročanja (Uradni list RS, št. 43/11 s spremembami in dopolnitvami, v nadaljnjem besedilu ZPVPJN). Navodila ponudnikom Stran 18/18 Zahtevek za revizijo se vloži preko portala e-Revizija. Vlagatelj mora skladno z 71. členom ZPVPJN plačati takso v višini 4.000,00 EUR na transakcijski račun Ministrstva za finance, št. 01100-1000358802, odprt pri Banki Slovenije, Slovenska 35, 1505 Ljubljana, sklic 11 16110-7111290-00010326, namen nakazila: taksa za postopek revizije javnega naročanja. Over the past decade, this ecosystem has expanded organically through project ‑by‑project deployments. As a result, the current environment is characterised by fragmentation, inconsistent branding, duplication of operational and hosting costs, varied technical standards, and increasingly complex governance and content‑management structures. A preliminary mapping exercise conducted by MTA has identified more than thirty (30) digital assets, including consumer‑facing websites, corporate platforms, country‑specific domains (e.g., 14 Unclassified France, Germany, Italy, the UK, Japan, Korea, and others), MICE ‑focused portals, event ‑driven microsites, and international representative sites. These range from high ‑traffic multilingual portals such as VisitMalta.com to legacy campaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal syst

mpaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal systems supporting media management, CRM, B2B services, and training. Social media channels and API ‑based integrations further contribute to the broader content flow and technical landscape. MTA’s strategic direction is to consolidate this extensive and heterogeneous digital landscape under a unified and coherent platform centred around VisitMalta.com. The objective is to improve user experience, reinforce consistent brand representation across all markets, streamline content and technical governance, and reduce long‑term operational, maintenance, and hosting costs. To support this strategic shift, MTA requires a comprehensive Web Environment Analysis and Requirements Definition Exercise. It shall assess the current ecosystem in full, map underlying systems and content flows, identify consolidation and rationalisation opportunities, and define the technical, functional, governance, integration, and procurement requirements. The findings will directly inform the preparation of a public tender, ensuring that the future solution is robust, scalable, interoperable, secure, and aligned with MTA’s long‑term digital transformation strategy. 1.6 - Related Programmes and Donor Activities T

on and adjudication process. Ultimately, the contract will ensure that MTA has the foundations required to implement a future-proof digital platform offering consistent branding, improved user experience, enhanced operational efficiency, and strengthened international visibility. 2.2 - Specific Objectives The objectives of this contract [which are not necessarily those of the project] are as follows: 1. To carry out a complete and validated analysis of MTA’s current digital ecosystem This objective focuses on discovering, mapping, auditing, and assessing all MTA digital assets, including domains, subdomains, microsites, hosting environments, CMS platforms, integrations, 15 Unclassified SEO structures, and compliance obligations. The Consultant must identify shadow sites, legacy components, security vulnerabilities, and operational inefficiencies to establish an authoritative baseline for consolidation. The Consultant shall categorise each asset using a Retain / Migrate / Redesign / Retire model. This objective ensures that strategic, technical, functional, and governance considerations guide which elements of the current web estate are preserved, redesig ned, consolidated, or phased out. 2. entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Use of the Panel The Contracting Authority will use this panel as and when requirements within its scope arise. Hij/zij evalueert problemen inzake informatieveiligheid, stelt veiligheidsbeleidslijnen op en brengt adviezen uit. Hij/zij verricht conformiteitsassessments t.o.v. het veiligheidsbeleid en wettelijke verplichtingen. Deze kunnen een operationeel, tactisch en strategisch karakter hebben. Hij/zij begeleidt veranderingsprocessen op organisatorisch, technisch en procesniveau. Hij/zij werkt op basis van risico-inschatting en risicoanalyse. When preparing a competitive quotation, vendors should take into consideration benefits provided through the national healthcare system. Quotations should refrain from over customization, and should be “off the shelf”, “commercially available”, or “market ready” products which are designed to be complementary and supplement to the national system in Portugal. The benefit levels listed from section C.1.1 through C.1.24 are a standard package that must be provided. C.1.1 Eligibility: To be eligible to participate in the medical plan, LE Staff (both full time and part time) must be: -- Paid under the terms of the Local Compensation Plan (LCP); and – -- Under a non-temporary direct hire appointment, personal services agreement (PSA), or personal services contract (PSC); or -- Under a temporary direct hire appointment or PSA Fixed Term of one year or more. Not eligible are those working under temporary appointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor l

ointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. Additionally, employee's dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment during which the employee was not eligible to participate. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

GENERAL The U.S. Government requires Health and Life Insurance for its Locally Employed Staff (LES) of the United States Embassy Lisbon, Portugal and their eligible dependents as described herein. The Contractor shall provide health insurance services under this contract to eligible employees at U.S. Embassy Lisbon and U.S. Consulate Ponta Delgada, Azores. TYPE OF CONTRACT 1. This is a fixed-price indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity (IDIQ) with economic price adjustment requirement under which annual firm-fixed price task orders will be issued. The fixed premium rates for the health insurance services as specified in Section C – Statement of Work provided herein are provided in Attachment 3 – Pricing Schedule. The quantities set forth in the pricing section are estimates; the Government does not guarantee that such quantities will be ordered. 2. The contract will be for a one base year period and four (4) one-year periods. In accordance with FAR 52.217-8, the contract may be extended by additional six (6) months period. Services shall commence no later than January 01, 2027. The Government is obligated only to the extent of authorized task orders actually made under this IDIQ. 3. Payments will be made only to the extent specifically authorized in the task order. Each task order will fund a specific period of time and number of covered individuals. Falls ja, welche Nachweise sind hierfür im Rahmen des Teilnahmeantrags bzw. Angebots erforderlich? Nein, neben festangestellten Mitarbeitenden können keine freien Mitarbeitende berücksichtigt werden (Dokument Erklärung zur Eignung, Punkt 2.2.1 Mitarbeiter) Sollten die geforderten personellen Eignungen mit den eigenen festangestellten Mitarbeitenden nicht vollständig erfüllt werden können, besteht die Möglichkeit, • eine Bietergemeinschaft zu bilden oder • eine Eignungsleihe in Anspruch zu nehmen. Falls ja, welche Nachweise sind hierfür im Rahmen des Teilnahmeantrags bzw. Angebots erforderlich? Nein, neben festangestellten Mitarbeitenden können keine freien Mitarbeitende berücksichtigt werden (Dokument Erklärung zur Eignung, Punkt 2.2.1 Mitarbeiter) Sollten die geforderten personellen Eignungen mit den eigenen festangestellten Mitarbeitenden nicht vollständig erfüllt werden können, besteht die Möglichkeit, • eine Bietergemeinschaft zu bilden oder • eine Eignungsleihe in Anspruch zu nehmen. Die jeweils erforderlichen Nachweise sind dann gemäß den Vorgaben der Vergabeunterlagen im Angebot beizubringen. Anhaenge, Seite: 2 lfd. nd Anlieferung angeht? Das Kommunikationskonzept ist anhand der drei geforderten Assets zu entwickeln und durch die Erläuterung mit maximal 500 Zeichen zu verdeutlichen. Eine darüberhinausgehende ausführliche Ausarbeitung ist nicht erforderlich. Die Bieter sollen jedoch erkennen lassen, welche übergeordnete kommunikative Idee den drei Assets zugrunde liegt und wie diese miteinander zusammenhängen. Eine gesonderte Präsentation oder ein zusätzliches Konzeptdokument wird hierfür nicht erwartet; die konzeptionelle Herleitung soll im Rahmen der geforderten 500-Zeichen-Erläuterung erfolgen. 7 Teil der Unterlagen sind die "Erklärung zum Nachunternehmereinsatz" sowie die "Verpflichtungs- und Eigenerklärung zur Eignungsleihe". Les 18 communes mettent ainsi en commun leurs moyens pour relever de grands projets et certains défis tels que ceux de l’attractivité du territoire, le développement économique et celui de l’emploi, le logement, les transports (réseau de bus), la construction de grands équipements (tel qu’AquaMalo), l’eau et l’assainissement, la prévention et la collecte des déchets ou encore le développement de formations d’enseignement supérieur ... V primeru skupne ponudbe lahko pogoj partnerji izpolnijo skupaj. V primeru, da ponudnik nastopa s podizvajalci, lahko pogoj ponudnik in podizvajalci dokazujejo skupno. DOKAZILO: - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz prve alineje prvega odstavka te točke: Izpolnjen obrazec P- 10 Referenca ponudnika. Referenca mora biti potrjena s strani naročnika referenčnega posla s podpisom. V kolikor se referenca nanaša na naročnika (Ministrstvo za zunanje in evropske zadeve), ponudnik izpolni vse podatke, vendar podpis reference s strani naročnika ni potreben. - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz druge alineje prvega odstavka te točke: ustrezna navedba v točki 3 obrazca P-2 Prijava in dokazila o izkušnjah ter sodelovanju strokovnjaka (npr. pogodba o zaposlitvi). 9.4.2 Vsi kadri ponudnika, ki bodo opravljali dela predmetnega javnega naročila, bodo varnostno preverjeni s strani naročnika v skladu z 16a. členom Zakona o zunanjih zadevah (Uradni list RS št. 113/03– uradno prečiščeno besedilo, s spremembami in dopo

zvesti javno naročilo s podizvajalcem, ki zahteva neposredno plačilo, mora: - glavni izvajalec v pogodbi pooblastiti naročnika, da na podlagi potrjenega računa oziroma situacije s strani glavnega izvajalca neposredno plačuje podizvajalcu, - podizvajalec predložiti soglasje, na podlagi katerega naročnik namesto ponudnika poravna podizvajalčevo terjatev do ponudnika, - glavni i zvajalec svojemu računu ali situaciji priložiti račun ali situacijo podizvajalca, ki ga je predhodno potrdil. V primeru nastopanja s podizvajalci, kjer ni neposrednega plačila, mora glavni izvajalec najpozneje v 60 dneh od plačila končnega računa oziroma situacije poslati naročniku svojo pisno izjavo in pisno izjavo podizvajalca, da je podizvajalec prejel plačilo za izvedene gradnje ali storitve oziroma dobavljeno blago, neposredno povezano s predmetom javnega naročila. V nasprotnem primeru naročnik Državni revizijski komisiji poda predlog za uvedbo postopka o prekršku iz 2. točke prvega odstavka 112. člena ZJN-3. Ponudnik v razmerju do naročnika v celoti odgovarja za izvedbo prejetega naročila, ne glede na število podizvajalcev, ki jih navede v svoji ponudbi. Izbrani izvajalec bo moral med izvajanjem javnega naročila naročnika obvestiti o morebitnih spremembah glede podizvajalcev, ki jih namerava nakn

avnem varstvu v postopkih javnega naročanja (Uradni list RS, št. 43/11 s spremembami in dopolnitvami, v nadaljnjem besedilu ZPVPJN). Navodila ponudnikom Stran 18/18 Zahtevek za revizijo se vloži preko portala e-Revizija. Vlagatelj mora skladno z 71. členom ZPVPJN plačati takso v višini 4.000,00 EUR na transakcijski račun Ministrstva za finance, št. 01100-1000358802, odprt pri Banki Slovenije, Slovenska 35, 1505 Ljubljana, sklic 11 16110-7111290-00010326, namen nakazila: taksa za postopek revizije javnega naročanja. Vlagatelj mora zahtevku za revizijo priložiti potrdilo o plačilu takse. veleposlanik Andrej Gregor Rode, v. d. generalnega sekretarja Objaviti: - na portalu javnih naročil. ===== FILE: files/Razpisna dokumentacija 103_26 EU JN MZEZ_unpacked/P-10 Referenca.docx ===== REFERENCA Izjavljamo, da je bil zgoraj naveden referenčni posel izveden strokovno, kvalitetno, pravočasno, v skladu s standardi in zahtevami naročnika in v skladu z določili pogodbe. Over the past decade, this ecosystem has expanded organically through project ‑by‑project deployments. As a result, the current environment is characterised by fragmentation, inconsistent branding, duplication of operational and hosting costs, varied technical standards, and increasingly complex governance and content‑management structures. A preliminary mapping exercise conducted by MTA has identified more than thirty (30) digital assets, including consumer‑facing websites, corporate platforms, country‑specific domains (e.g., 14 Unclassified France, Germany, Italy, the UK, Japan, Korea, and others), MICE ‑focused portals, event ‑driven microsites, and international representative sites. These range from high ‑traffic multilingual portals such as VisitMalta.com to legacy campaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal syst

mpaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal systems supporting media management, CRM, B2B services, and training. Social media channels and API ‑based integrations further contribute to the broader content flow and technical landscape. MTA’s strategic direction is to consolidate this extensive and heterogeneous digital landscape under a unified and coherent platform centred around VisitMalta.com. The objective is to improve user experience, reinforce consistent brand representation across all markets, streamline content and technical governance, and reduce long‑term operational, maintenance, and hosting costs. To support this strategic shift, MTA requires a comprehensive Web Environment Analysis and Requirements Definition Exercise. It shall assess the current ecosystem in full, map underlying systems and content flows, identify consolidation and rationalisation opportunities, and define the technical, functional, governance, integration, and procurement requirements. The findings will directly inform the preparation of a public tender, ensuring that the future solution is robust, scalable, interoperable, secure, and aligned with MTA’s long‑term digital transformation strategy. 1.6 - Related Programmes and Donor Activities T

on and adjudication process. Ultimately, the contract will ensure that MTA has the foundations required to implement a future-proof digital platform offering consistent branding, improved user experience, enhanced operational efficiency, and strengthened international visibility. 2.2 - Specific Objectives The objectives of this contract [which are not necessarily those of the project] are as follows: 1. To carry out a complete and validated analysis of MTA’s current digital ecosystem This objective focuses on discovering, mapping, auditing, and assessing all MTA digital assets, including domains, subdomains, microsites, hosting environments, CMS platforms, integrations, 15 Unclassified SEO structures, and compliance obligations. The Consultant must identify shadow sites, legacy components, security vulnerabilities, and operational inefficiencies to establish an authoritative baseline for consolidation. The Consultant shall categorise each asset using a Retain / Migrate / Redesign / Retire model. This objective ensures that strategic, technical, functional, and governance considerations guide which elements of the current web estate are preserved, redesig ned, consolidated, or phased out. 2. entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Use of the Panel The Contracting Authority will use this panel as and when requirements within its scope arise. Hij/zij evalueert problemen inzake informatieveiligheid, stelt veiligheidsbeleidslijnen op en brengt adviezen uit. Hij/zij verricht conformiteitsassessments t.o.v. het veiligheidsbeleid en wettelijke verplichtingen. Deze kunnen een operationeel, tactisch en strategisch karakter hebben. Hij/zij begeleidt veranderingsprocessen op organisatorisch, technisch en procesniveau. Hij/zij werkt op basis van risico-inschatting en risicoanalyse. When preparing a competitive quotation, vendors should take into consideration benefits provided through the national healthcare system. Quotations should refrain from over customization, and should be “off the shelf”, “commercially available”, or “market ready” products which are designed to be complementary and supplement to the national system in Portugal. The benefit levels listed from section C.1.1 through C.1.24 are a standard package that must be provided. C.1.1 Eligibility: To be eligible to participate in the medical plan, LE Staff (both full time and part time) must be: -- Paid under the terms of the Local Compensation Plan (LCP); and – -- Under a non-temporary direct hire appointment, personal services agreement (PSA), or personal services contract (PSC); or -- Under a temporary direct hire appointment or PSA Fixed Term of one year or more. Not eligible are those working under temporary appointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor l

ointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. Additionally, employee's dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment during which the employee was not eligible to participate. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

GENERAL The U.S. Government requires Health and Life Insurance for its Locally Employed Staff (LES) of the United States Embassy Lisbon, Portugal and their eligible dependents as described herein. The Contractor shall provide health insurance services under this contract to eligible employees at U.S. Embassy Lisbon and U.S. Consulate Ponta Delgada, Azores. TYPE OF CONTRACT 1. This is a fixed-price indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity (IDIQ) with economic price adjustment requirement under which annual firm-fixed price task orders will be issued. The fixed premium rates for the health insurance services as specified in Section C – Statement of Work provided herein are provided in Attachment 3 – Pricing Schedule. The quantities set forth in the pricing section are estimates; the Government does not guarantee that such quantities will be ordered. 2. The contract will be for a one base year period and four (4) one-year periods. In accordance with FAR 52.217-8, the contract may be extended by additional six (6) months period. Services shall commence no later than January 01, 2027. The Government is obligated only to the extent of authorized task orders actually made under this IDIQ. 3. Payments will be made only to the extent specifically authorized in the task order. Each task order will fund a specific period of time and number of covered individuals.
